name: Curvy Vampirebat 60
author: gharsh11032000
description: Neon pill sky-blue radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-50%) scale(1.2), border-color becomes #4c8bf5, box-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #4c8bf580. Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes translateY(-50%) scale(0.9), border becomes 5px solid #4c8bf5, text color changes from #fff to #4c8bf5.
